record.context_brief: strict deformation quantization of foliated cotangent algebra
record.original_question: Can one construct a strict deformation quantization, in the sense of Rieffel, of the noncommutative algebra C^infinity_prop(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}) that models the cotangent bundle of the leaf space of a Riemannian foliation?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.7. To construct (strict) deformation quantization of the algebra C^infinity_prop(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}) (in the sense of Rieffel [48, 49, 50, 51]).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,\mathcal{F})$ be a smooth Riemannian foliation on a compact manifold $M$. Let $G_{\mathcal{F}}$ denote its holonomy groupoid and let $G_{\mathcal{F}}^N \to N$ denote the transverse (normal) groupoid associated with a complete transversal $N$, with associated tangent groupoid $TG_N$. Consider the convolution algebra $C^{\infty}_{\mathrm{prop}}(G_{\mathcal{F}}^N, |TG_N|^{1/2})$ of properly supported smooth half-densities on $G_{\mathcal{F}}^N$, which serves as a noncommutative model for the algebra of smooth functions on the cotangent bundle of the leaf space $M/\mathcal{F}$, carrying a natural Poisson structure.

Problem: Construct a strict deformation quantization of $C^{\infty}_{\mathrm{prop}}(G_{\mathcal{F}}^N, |TG_N|^{1/2})$ in the sense of Rieffel; that is, construct a continuous field $\{A_\hbar\}_{\hbar\in[0,1]}$ of $C^*$-algebras together with a dense $*$-subalgebra of sections containing the given algebra at $\hbar=0$, such that for any two elements $f,g$, the section $\hbar \mapsto f\star_\hbar g$ is continuous and satisfies
$$\Big\| \frac{f\star_\hbar g - g\star_\hbar f}{i\hbar} - \{f,g\} \Big\|_\hbar \longrightarrow 0 \quad \text{as } \hbar\to 0,$$
where $\{\cdot,\cdot\}$ is the natural Poisson bracket on the noncommutative cotangent algebra of the leaf space.
artifact.category_tag: Strict deformation quantization of foliation groupoids
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return a paper explicitly carrying out a strict deformation quantization, in Rieffel's sense, of the convolution algebra $C^\infty_{\mathrm{prop}}(G_{\mathcal{F}}^N,|TG_N|^{1/2})$ modelling the cotangent bundle of the leaf space of a Riemannian foliation. Related results exist on tangent groupoid constructions and strict quantization for Riemannian manifolds and on generalizations of Rieffel's quantization to non-abelian group actions, but no direct resolution of the specific foliation problem was found. The status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Recent Developments in Deformation Quantization
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of strict deformation quantization including Rieffel's framework and extensions; no resolution for foliation cotangent algebras noted.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit construction of Rieffel-strict deformation quantization for the leaf-space cotangent algebra of Riemannian foliations is reported.

status_evidence.title: Connes' Tangent Groupoid and Deformation Quantization
status_evidence.snippet: Strict flabby quantization on Riemannian manifolds via tangent groupoids; foliation/leaf-space case not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Related strict quantization results exist for manifolds but not for the foliation groupoid algebra in question.
